MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

5. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.

8. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.

9. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.

10. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

11. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.

12. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Live streaming Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
